categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the industrial anti-corrosion and wear-resistant welding equipment sector, focusing on the research, production, and sales of special welding core technologies. It also produces non-welded boiler parts, pressure vessels, and high-end steel structural components. Its products serve industries such as energy-saving environmental protection, power, energy, chemical, metallurgy, and paper-making, with a major application in the waste incineration power generation sector.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in special welding technologies including overlay welding, laser overlay welding, and secondary remelting. It has developed key core technologies covering materials, processes, and equipment, addressing challenges like uniformity, dilution rate, and thickness in large-area overlay welding. Production emphasizes automation and intelligent manufacturing, utilizing digital pulse MIG welding, laser overlay, and CNC intelligent equipment systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic energy-saving environmental protection operators, energy equipment manufacturers, and international enterprises such as GE, Mitsubishi, and Hitachi. The main markets served are waste incineration power generation, coal-fired power generation, biomass power generation, chemical, metallurgy, and paper-making industries. The company also actively expands overseas markets in countries including the US, UK, Canada, Germany, and Vietnam.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and production bases in Guangdong Province. It has established subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Vietnam to support overseas market expansion. Its international projects span North America, Europe, Asia, and Oceania, including countries like the US, UK, Canada, Germany, Finland, Poland, Brazil, Mexico, Saudi Arabia, Bangladesh, India, South Korea, Australia, Japan, and Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the industrial equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying specialized welding equipment and components that enhance the durability and performance of industrial equipment. It provides customized products directly to equipment manufacturers and operators, playing a critical role in extending equipment life and improving operational efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on building a special welding technology application platform to expand product varieties, application fields, and international markets. R&D priorities include developing new alloy materials, advanced welding processes like laser overlay and secondary remelting, and enhancing automation and intelligent manufacturing capabilities. It also emphasizes collaboration with universities and research institutions to drive innovation and product competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the production and sales of anti-corrosion and wear-resistant overlay welding equipment, along with non-welded boiler parts, pressure vessels, and high-end steel structural components. Sales are conducted mainly via bidding and business negotiations with large state-owned enterprises, listed companies, and international customers. The company also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the earliest and leading domestic enterprises in industrial anti-corrosion and wear-resistant overlay welding, with significant scale production capabilities and recognized certifications such as the national special equipment production license and ASME certifications. It holds a strong market position in the waste incineration power generation sector and is expanding into coal-fired power, biomass power, and other industrial fields. Competitors include other domestic and international manufacturers in the surface engineering and industrial equipment sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 460.3 million, a 23.76% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 69.4 million, down 47.02%. Total assets reached RMB 2.54 billion, showing slight growth. The company has experienced fluctuations in revenue and profit but maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues investing in production capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-quality, economically efficient special welding products that significantly enhance industrial equipment's resistance to corrosion, wear, high temperature, and high pressure. Its proprietary technologies improve product uniformity, reduce dilution rates, and extend equipment lifespan, thereby reducing downtime and maintenance costs for customers. The company’s scale production, technical certifications, and strong customer relationships provide competitive advantages in both domestic and international markets.
